method: git ls-files; decode UTF-8 with replacement; Python str.splitlines() counts physical lines including comments and blank lines; nonblank means line.strip() is nonempty. Bytes are filesystem stat sizes.
scope: Tracked files only. Main source comprises src/**/*.js, src/**/*.ts and src/**/*.vue outside src/unused. CSS is tracked css subtree. Data/docs/unused are reported separately.
exclusions: Main source excludes src/unused, data, docs, root build/config scripts, dependency lockfile, generated artifacts and dependencies. Main source can still include legacy/optional systems, e.g. cloud persistence, so is not an active/shipped executable LOC count.

verification.coverage: Exact evidence paths metadata-match/no recorded issue; src/css/data scopes no recorded issue; docs excluded and directly read; Vue main component function symbols unavailable, directly read.
